notable_absence.finding: This page breaks from the credential-type/privilege pair pattern seen throughout this round's DML statements: 'You do not need credentials for the Search Service to be able to use the search functions in a query.' Instead, access is gated by named data-plane RBAC roles (Data Admin, Data Reader) - a third, previously-unseen-in-this-batch gating axis alongside capella-role:* (management-plane) and cluster-access-credential-type (data-plane, credential-keyed). This is a genuine new data point for the hypothesis: the credential-type model does NOT extend cleanly to every corner of the DDL/query surface - Search-integration functions sit outside it entirely.

cross_component_finding: Recurrence of the known issue in docs-issues/capella-pages-cite-server-versions.json: this page cites 'Couchbase Server version 7.6.2' and 'Couchbase Server 7.6' multiple times as feature gates ('If your cluster is running Couchbase Server version 7.6.2 and later, you can also use the search functions to use document metadata stored in Extended Attributes...'; '(Version 7.6.2) Search with XATTRs data and no suitable Search index'), despite Capella having no discrete version numbers. Also notable: the page links to '[Demonstration Indexes](#server:fts:fts-demonstration-indexes.adoc)' - an unresolved cross-component xref pointing directly into the server/ module's FTS documentation rather than a Capella-authored equivalent, and to Capella-specific role/user management ('For information on creating users and roles in Capella, see [Manage Organizations and Access]').
